shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular field
register-like horizontal bands of repeated motifs
a row of repeated arch-like or vessel-like shapes along an upper band
justification: Both are low-relief panels organised into horizontal registers with rows of repeated motifs, and both include profile animal/creature figures, but that is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a specific narrative scene of human figures with elongated bodies adoring a rayed disc above an offering table laden with vessels, flanked by dense columns of script signs, whereas B shows only isolated schematic animals (a crouching predator, a bird-like creature, a reptile) and abstract arch and zigzag bands with no human figures, no disc and no text.
